tagline.en: Cloudflare is gone. Tick "I'm not a robot" and log in.
tagline.id: Cloudflare dihapus. Centang "I'm not a robot" lalu login.

items.en: Login, sign-up and password reset now use our own "I'm not a robot" check. The Cloudflare box that failed to load is removed.
items.id: Login, daftar, dan reset password sekarang pakai cek "I'm not a robot" bawaan. Kotak Cloudflare yang gagal dimuat dihapus.
